scope: Development pilot for separating mask coverage from mask-position selection on the already exposed chicken and zebrafish native-AUGUSTUS panels; no new training, species, seed, D threshold, or region selection.

arms.D_FIXED: The already generated D FASTA and the already completed D GFF from NONMAMMAL-GENE-UTILITY-20260918; immutable reference arm.
arms.RM2_FULL: The complete native RepeatModeler2/RepeatMasker masked FASTA extracted on the same 5,200,000-bp input.
arms.D_COMMON_RANDOM: D mask downsampled by fixed length strata and deterministic coordinate hash to the common stratum budget; intervention arm, not the original D result.
arms.RM2_COMMON_RANDOM: RM2 mask downsampled by the same fixed length strata and deterministic coordinate hash to the common stratum budget.
arms.RM2_COMMON_CONF: RM2 mask selected to the identical common stratum budget by native RepeatMasker alignment confidence, before any downstream score is read.

common_budget.unit: one fixed core-plus-halo input per existing panel core
common_budget.stratum_definition: A merged lowercase A/C/G/T run is assigned by its complete input length; the upper bound is exclusive except for the final open bin.
common_budget.per_stratum_target: min(D_FIXED masked bp in stratum, RM2_FULL masked bp in stratum)
common_budget.total_target: sum of the per-stratum targets; this intersection budget is used even when it is smaller than min(total D, total RM2), so no unmatched length bin is filled.
common_budget.random_order: stable SHA-256 priority of protocol seed, species, core ID, arm, run start and run end; no score or reference label is used
common_budget.partial_run_rule: If the last selected run would exceed its stratum target, retain the centered subinterval of the exact remaining length. The resulting selected bp is exact per stratum.
common_budget.halo_rule: Mask runs are selected and counted over the full core-plus-halo input. Core-only and left/right halo masked bp, plus actual output-run length strata, are reported separately and never used to change the target after preparation.

rm2_confidence.run_annotation: Each RM2_FULL lowercase run receives the best overlapping native alignment record.
rm2_confidence.ties: All listed fields and then the stable genomic coordinates are used; no downstream gene score or CDS annotation is used.
rm2_confidence.missing_alignment: Retain the run in RM2_FULL audit; rank it after runs with a native record in RM2_COMMON_CONF and report the count.

augustus.parameter_source: existing same-species chicken/zebrafish parameters from NONMAMMAL-GENE-UTILITY-20260918

score.reference: the unchanged exact-assembly protein-coding reference.json from NONMAMMAL-GENE-UTILITY-20260918
score.unit: the unchanged complete CDS-chain locus unit
score.primary_diagnostic: D_COMMON_RANDOM versus RM2_COMMON_RANDOM and RM2_COMMON_CONF at the shared budget
score.interpretation: Chromosome-bootstrap intervals are regional sensitivity intervals, not biological replicate uncertainty; this pilot is development evidence and cannot be promoted to an independent confirmation result.

stopping: Complete preparation, all four new AUGUSTUS arms on all ten existing cores per species, and the paired score for both species irrespective of effect direction. Do not replace a core, alter a threshold, or add a seed after reading any output.
